stem: A team is documenting DynamoDB capacity math for a payment ledger table that has mixed read consistency requirements. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: One RCU supports one strongly consistent read per second for an item up to 4 KB.
One RCU supports one write per second for an item up to 4 KB.
One on-demand request unit always equals one 8 KB transactional write.
One WCU supports one write per second for an item up to 1 KB.
One WCU supports one strongly consistent read per second for an item up to 1 KB.

rationale: The documented definitions are 1 RCU for a 4 KB strongly consistent read per second and 1 WCU for a 1 KB write per second. The reversed statements swap read and write semantics and are incorrect. On-demand request billing is not defined as a fixed 8 KB transactional write unit across all operations.
